title: Speed: loop step count
prompt:
SPEED DRILL — target under 90 seconds.

How many times does the body run?

```java
for (int i = 0; i < 5; i += 2) { /* body */ }
```

A. 2
B. 2.5
C. 3
D. 5

Call `answer(...)` exactly once with your option letter and a one-sentence reason.

tests.name: C speed
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.answer("C. check"));
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("C"), "answer must start with the correct option letter");
tests.hint: C. i takes 0, 2, 4 — three iterations ((4-0)/2 + 1). B is not an integer; A miscounts the off-by-one; D ignores the step.
